items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: he picked up on the idea of the two of us going into the thing, his wife jumped on it and we pushed to the point where it was suggested that somebody approach the record companies

ctx.x: Irv Denken was the trombone player in McKinley's band, got to be at this point a booker with Willard Alexander, although he was still playing trombone, and he picked up on the idea of the two of us going into the thing, his wife jumped on it and we pushed to the point where it was suggested that somebody approach the record companies and see how they would like it.
Both Columbia and RCA did, and for some reason we went with RCA. We wanted one of those composite titles,
